title: Scope Secure Enclave key custody for macOS
description: Scoping only: assess Secure Enclave-backed key custody for the macOS vault key as a possible successor to the login-keychain item (ADR 0001). Filed on the operator's decision (first-party in opum-doc): file it, do not start it. It competes for a slot in a later weekly plan and is outside this week's scope.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A scoping note states what Secure Enclave custody would change for the vault key, what it needs from the build and signing path, and what it would cost, with the decision it asks of the operator as an A/B choice
